product_metadata.title: Avalon Cabana Beach Towels - (Value Pack of 4) Size 30x60 Inch 100% Ring Spun Cotton, Highly Absorbent Large Pool Towels, Super Soft and Quick Drying, Perfect for Gifts (Blue Stripe)
features: LUXURIOUS QUALITY: These amazing beach towels are made with 100% ring spun cotton that makes them highly absorbent and super soft and as soon as you'll wrap these towels around you the warmth feeling will make you even more pleasant.
VALUE PACK: These pool towels set includes 4 towels measuring 30x60 Inches making them a very economical pack that you and your family can definitely use on the beach or by the pool.

MULTIPURPOSE: Beautiful pattern and design, these cabana stripe beach towels can also be used as home bath towels, hotel towels, resort pool towels, gym towels, spa towels and can also be given to your loved ones as a present.
ECO-FRIENDLY: These pool beach towel set is made from purely natural, eco-friendly cotton, free from harsh chemicals and harmful dye making it safe for you, your family and the environment.
EASY CARE: Hand and machine washable, these towels are very durable and and will last a lifetime. With a value pack of 4 you will never run out of towels again.
